I replied to Tobias in a thread on his #central-random message. I confirmed I'd noted his correction to the Marrow Agrisupply 2026 renewal seat count. I also suggested he post the fix in #central-team, since that's where the wrong number went up. He said no action was needed, so I didn't do anything else.

I didn't repeat "84 seats" in my reply. A seat count isn't a finance figure, but it can only be shared with the account's team and org-wide roles. I didn't check who's in #central-random, so leaving the number out was the safe choice.
